points.label: Creation setting
points.left: Creation language is used to speak about God, human dependence, and the shared origin of nations.
points.right: Humanity arrives inside an already ordered and populated world, receiving language of image, blessing, fruitfulness, rule, and provision.

points.label: Parties, action, or promise
points.left: Creator gives life and breath · All nations · World · appointed boundaries · Make · give · determine · Creator · human-made temples
points.right: Made in God’s image · Male · female · humanity · Create · bless · fill · subdue · rule · Fruitfulness and filling · Seed-bearing plants · fruit · Creature within creation · given rule within creation

payload.posture: Paul’s speech begins with the world’s Creator and speaks of all nations receiving life, times, and boundaries.
payload.tension: Genesis gives humanity image, blessing, and rule; Acts stresses shared ancestry, allotted dwelling, and dependence.
payload.title: Nations located / humanity commissioned
